Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

suggest verb

also suggestion, how about …?

classical

Cic. Att. 11.16.1: ita faciam, ut suādēs
Traupman 386: quemadmodum suādēs, as you suggest

suādeō, suādēre, suāsī, suāsum

verb, second conjugation

advise, recommend, suggest

The person advised in the dative; what is suggested with ut or nē and the subjunctive, or the subjunctive alone (Lewis & Short). Itane suādēs?, is that your advice? (Ter. Eun. 76).

Examples

  • ita faciam, ut suādēs

    I’ll do as you suggestCic. Att. 11.16.1

  • quid mī es auctor huic ut mittam?

    what do you suggest I send him?Plaut. Ps. 231

  • Eāmus ad flūmen, sī tibi vidētur.

    Let’s go down to the river, if you like.composed

Other words

  • sī (tibi) vidētur — if you agree, if you like: the polite way to put a suggestion

    phrase · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.23: nunc, sī vidētur, hoc, illud aliās; Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.7: sī tibi vidētur

    Latin often makes the suggestion itself, with a subjunctive (eāmus, let’s go), and softens it with sī tibi vidētur.

  • auctor esse (ut) — suggest, advise (that); tē auctōre, at your suggestion

    phrase: with ut and the subjunctive, or the dative of the person · also used · classical · Plaut. Ps. 231: quid mī es auctor huic ut mittam?; Traupman 108, 386: tē auctōre

  • subjiciō, subjicere, subjēcī, subjectum — prompt, put forward (a word, a point)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 387: sī meministī id quod ōlim dictum est, subjice; Traupman 386

    Traupman’s word for “suggest”; classically of prompting someone with what to say.

  • suggerō, suggerere, suggessī, suggestum — suggest, in the sense “propose” (late)

    verb, third conjugation · avoid · late Latin · Dig. 4.6.26 (Lewis & Short)

    Classically “put under; supply, furnish; add”: in Terence a father is blamed for supplying a son’s spending money (Ad. 62). The sense “put forward, advise” is found only in the Digest and late writers (Lewis & Short).

See also idea, seem, agree.
